description: Bringing Healthcare Back to New MexicoJahnelle Garcia, MSN APRN FNP-C Nurse Practitioner Candidate for New Mexico HD 27 Executive SummaryNew Mexico is facing a critical healthcare access crisis that affects families in every region of the state. Limited access to providers, long wait times, and shortages in mental health services have created significant barriers to care. These challenges are not partisan issues, they affect Republicans, Democrats, Independents, and every New Mexican community.C
title: The Bipartisan Importance of Addressing the Healthcare Crisis in New Mexico
